findings.citation: DESIGN.md Month bar: "The month and its state read on the left as one sentence"; "Sent: IconCheckCircle (h-3.5, success) and one sentence, 'Sent to Manager on {date}'"
findings.note: The sent state wraps check + sentence in an inline-flex span that can't break: at mobile it drops to line 2 as a block, leaving 'September 2026 ·' alone on line 1 (remove-confirm-open-mobile, files-paused-mobile goldens); on desktop 'September 2026 ·' sits ~2px below the sentence's baseline (files-paused-desktop-light). Fix: icon inline aligned to text (e.g. inline align-[-2px]) so the sentence wraps as text on one baseline.
findings.reason: Sent bar check inline, one baseline; wraps as text at 390 (files-paused, remove-confirm goldens).

findings.citation: spec Design direction / DESIGN.md Side list Row: "line 2 left reads '✓ Ready' … or '{n} files missing' (ink-mute), after the Country when shown"
findings.note: Track list minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,auto)_auto puts readiness in track 2 after the 1fr track, so with a short Country it floats next to the badge column ('Mexico' ~25px gap '· ✓ Ready'). The visual test only checks x >= country right edge with a truncating 'United Kingdom', hiding the gap. Fix: Country and readiness in one flex span on line 2 (Country truncating, readiness shrink-0), or track 1 minmax(0,auto) plus a trailing 1fr spacer; tighten the test with a short Country.
findings.reason: Readiness follows the Country directly; short-Country bounding-box test.

findings.citation: DESIGN.md Month bar: "The month and its state read on the left as one sentence … the action on the right"; "The confirm is the Client Invoice Send's two-step inline confirm"
findings.note: The confirm state replaces the whole bar, so 'September 2026 · 2 of 2 ready' disappears while confirming; the card's Send confirm replaces only the trigger. Fix: keep the left text and swap only the trigger column for the confirm copy and buttons.
